title: 暖灯外倾静态伸手
description: 油画笔触表现暖灯下浅外倾墙上的短静态伸手。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional adult making a short static reach under warm gym lights on a shallow overhanging panel. One hand remains on a broad blue jug, both feet press positive low footholds, and the body stays near the wall as the other hand approaches a neighboring edge. Show a wide oblique composition with visible wall angle, the whole opaque-clothed figure, and uninterrupted crash mats below. Use rich amber light, blue-gray shadows, and visible impasto to distinguish clothing from wall texture. Keep the landing area empty. The scene is calm and anatomically believable, with no swing, jump, text, brand, or exposed height.
